ownerFieldNote.body: The Colorado statewide parcel layer documents an owner column, but it is not populated for El Paso County. A live sample of 300 records filtered to countyName='EL PASO' returned no value in any row, so no query can retrieve ownership here. This is El Paso County, Colorado; El Paso County, Texas is a separate record in this atlas and does publish owner names on its own layer. The parcel id is populated and searchable; the situs address, situs city and ZIP, legal description, sale date and appraised value columns also measure empty for this county, while other counties on the same statewide layer, such as Denver and Jefferson, are fully populated. Ownership is available from the county Assessor.

counties.notes: El Paso County (Colorado Springs metro, pop. 730,000, county seat Colorado Springs) is the second-most populous Colorado county and home to Fort Carson, Peterson Space Force Base, and Schriever Space Force Base. Like all Colorado counties, it uses the Colorado Governor's OIT statewide composite endpoint, query by countyName='El Paso' or countyFips='041' (the statewide layer uses the 3-digit county FIPS, not the full 5-digit '08041'). Owner query confirmed live with real Colorado Springs results (e.g., 'SMITH CHERYL LYNNE'). The composite layer exposes parcel_id, owner/owner2, ownerAdd/ownAddCty/ownAddStt/ownAddZip, situsAdd/sitAddCty/sitAddZip, legalDesc, landSqft/landAcres, zoningCode/zoningDesc, landUseCde/landUseDsc, saleDate, salePrice, apprValTot, asedValTot, and dateReceived (currency indicator for when each county's data was loaded). The El Paso County Assessor at assessor.elpasoco.com handles formal reassessment disputes. Colorado assesses on a biennial cycle, unlike Illinois or California, which use triennial or annual schedules.

counties.notes: Jefferson County (Denver's west-side suburbs, Lakewood, Arvada, Wheat Ridge, Evergreen, Golden; pop. 582,000, county seat Golden) is a mixed urban-mountain county extending from the Denver metro edge into the foothills and lower Rockies. Like all Colorado counties, it uses the Colorado Governor's OIT statewide composite endpoint, query by countyName='Jefferson' or countyFips='059' (3-digit county portion; full 5-digit is '08059'). Owner query confirmed live: returns real Jefferson County results (e.g., 'SMITH STEVEN W' at '7347 W FREMONT DR LITTLETON'). The composite layer exposes parcel_id, owner/owner2 (owner name fields), ownerAdd/ownAddCty/ownAddStt/ownAddZip (owner mailing address), situsAdd/sitAddCty/sitAddZip (situs address), legalDesc, landSqft/landAcres, zoningCode/zoningDesc, landUseCde/landUseDsc, saleDate/salePrice, apprValTot/asedValTot, and dateReceived. The Jefferson County Assessor at jeffco.us/1304/Assessor administers biennial reassessments (Colorado assesses on a two-year cycle, not triennial). Open-data downloads available at jeffco.us/GIS.
